findings.message: Concurrent reclaimers can quarantine a newly acquired live guard using stale ownership evidence.

Serialize reclamation and acquisition so stale evidence cannot authorize renaming a replacement guard. The existing cross-process test starts with an absent guard; the worker race tests only competition after quarantine, so neither asserts this interleaving.
